Journal-specific values (word limits, abstract structure/limit, section orders, exact reference caps, keyword count, declarations order, table placement) are therefore NULL. Non-null layout/figure/heading/title-case values were encoded from Taylor & Francis cross-publisher HOUSE-STYLE pages rendered headless via Apify (authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com journal-manuscript-layout-guide + submit-electronic-artwork, both HTTP 200), NOT from this journal's own guide. encoding_notes: LIVE GUIDE BOT-BLOCKED: tandfonline.com Instructions for Authors (rjsp20) returned 403 Cloudflare on WebFetch and on Apify headless render; the whole tandfonline.com domain (incl. journal homepage + mc.manuscriptcentral.com/rjsp portal) is Cloudflare-protected. No Wayback snapshot within 12 months carries real content — the instructions URL only has a 301 redirect (2026-01-09) chaining to a 403 challenge blob (2025-04-14). All journal-specific numeric/structural values left null per accuracy-over-completeness.

layout.font (Times New Roman 12), line_spacing (double), margins_mm (25.4 all = 1 inch / 2.5cm), the 3-level headings scheme, misc.title_case (sentence), and running_head (not required at submission) = Taylor & Francis HOUSE-STYLE, encoded from authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/publishing-your-research/writing-your-paper/journal-manuscript-layout-guide/ (headless, HTTP 200: 'Use Times New Roman font in size 12 with double-line spacing.'; 'Margins should be at least 2.5cm (1 inch).'; 'First-level headings... bold'; 'Second-level headings... bold italics'; 'Third-level headings... italics'; 'Running heads... aren't required when submitting a manuscript for review.'). NOT this journal's own guide; may be overridden by the live JSS instructions. Note: many T&F journals offer optional format-free submission.

figures block (separate_files, formats tiff/jpeg/eps, min_dpi, legends in manuscript text, Figure {n} naming) = T&F house-style from authorservices submit-electronic-artwork (headless, HTTP 200): 'You must save figures separately to text, do not embed them in the manuscript file.'; peer-review preferred formats JPEG/TIFF (+ Word DOC/DOCX); EPS recommended for line art; captions supplied separately in the manuscript text file, not with image files; 'name artwork files as Figure 1, 2, 3... according to the order they appear in the text.'

SCHEMA GAP - tiered figure DPI: T&F house-style specifies color photographic 300dpi, grayscale photographic 600dpi, line-art/monochrome 1200dpi, combination 600dpi; schema holds one min_dpi so set to the 300 floor (color photos).

blinding = double-anonymized: WebSearch surfaced the standardized T&F peer-review statement for this journal ('All research and review articles in the Journal of Sports Sciences have undergone rigorous peer review, based on initial editor screening and anonymized (double-anonymized) refereeing by at least two referees.'). double_blind=true; separate_title_page + scrub flags are the standard corollaries. VERIFY against the live Instructions for Authors.

references: JSS uses AUTHOR-DATE (Harvard/APA-like) citation, WebSearch-corroborated ('References should be cited in the text by name and year in parentheses'). style set to 'custom' because author-date does not map to the numbered enums (nlm/ama/vancouver); in_text='paren' (name+year in parentheses); order='alphabetical' (definitional for author-date lists). in_text_punctuation, journal_abbrev, et_al_threshold, max_count left null (not verifiable from the blocked live guide). include_doi=false (house-style recommends DOIs but they are not mandatory; JSS-specific requirement unverified). Re-encode when the live guide is reachable.

article_types = original_research + review, DIRECTLY corroborated by the peer-review statement quote 'All research and review articles in the Journal of Sports Sciences...' JSS is a sports/exercise SCIENCE journal (physiology, biomechanics, performance analysis, psychology) and does NOT publish clinical case reports, so case_report is intentionally omitted. JSS also publishes systematic reviews / meta-analyses (would map to review or systematic_review) but the authoritative article-type list + distinct submission-category names live in the blocked guide.

submission_system = ScholarOne Manuscripts: the T&F artwork house-style names ScholarOne + Editorial Manager as the platforms; JSS's ScholarOne portal endpoint mc.manuscriptcentral.com/rjsp exists (returned a Cloudflare 403, i.e. a live protected page not a 404). Not independently confirmed this session; verify against the live guide.
ISSN 0264-0414 print / 1466-447X online and publisher Taylor & Francis (Routledge) WebSearch-corroborated; JSS is Medline- and Clarivate-listed.

abstract.structured=false, keywords.required=true, misc booleans (orcid/cover_letter false, highlights null), title_page.elements, and page_size=null are house-style-inferred or conservative defaults, NOT JSS-verified (blocked guide). T&F house-style default for keyword count is 'five or six' when the journal doesn't specify, but the JSS-specific count is unknown so keywords.min/max left null.

line_numbers=none reflects the T&F standard-formatting house-style (the layout guide does not mandate line numbers). CAVEAT: if JSS is enrolled in T&F format-free submission, the format-free house-style requires 'double spacing and line numbers' — confirm on the live guide.

declarations.order=[] and required=null: the JSS-specific declaration ordering is unverifiable (blocked guide). House-style does place the Data availability statement within the manuscript text, before the References section, under the heading 'Data availability statement'.
sections {} and word_limits {} intentionally empty - no per-type section order or word cap could be verified from the blocked live guide.
[schema-required default] references.journal_abbrev defaulted to 'nlm' (guide silent; NLM/Index Medicus abbreviations assumed).
